scenario_a_config_and_name_drift.symptom: Diagnosis commands return 'No such container' or empty grep matches despite valid syntax
scenario_a_config_and_name_drift.root_cause: Documentation drifted behind infrastructure changes (e.g., container renamed or env var key changed without updating the runbook).
scenario_a_config_and_name_drift.prevention: Prepend a runtime discovery verification line (`docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Ports}}\t{{.Status}}'`) at Step 0 and enforce runbook PR-review checklist checks whenever container names, ports, or env schemas change.

scenario_b_missing_dependency_step.symptom: Every documented restart step succeeds, yet post-restart verification still fails
scenario_b_missing_dependency_step.root_cause: An undocumented operational prerequisite (e.g., background worker container, Redis sidecar, or Prisma migration/warm-up step) was added without updating the runbook.
scenario_b_missing_dependency_step.prevention: Enumerate all co-dependent services (`linkscale-api`, `linkops-postgres`, `linkops-redis`, worker process) in Step 0 topology verification and couple runbook review with architecture changes.

scenario_c_ambiguous_target_or_port.symptom: curl returns Connection Refused on localhost:3000 or operator risks restarting the wrong container
scenario_c_ambiguous_target_or_port.root_cause: Service listening port or multi-container replica naming diverged from hardcoded assumptions.
scenario_c_ambiguous_target_or_port.prevention: Document exact container labels/filters (`docker ps --filter label=service=linkscale`) and confirm active listening port from container inspection before executing probes or restarts.
